description: This Figshare collection updates China's national and provincial energy and carbon dioxide accounts for 2016 and 2017. Six child items separate energy use from emissions and provide both sectoral and reference accounting approaches. The Scientific Data descriptor reports 1,172 inventory records across thirty provinces and national totals. A modeller can use the accounts to check energy-sector emissions or calibrate regional industrial transition scenarios. The two accounting approaches are alternative calculations, not independent observations to add together. The 2016–2017 span is short and should be joined to older series only after sector definitions and fuel categories are reconciled. DataCite and each member item report CC BY 4.0. I read the own collection and member metadata and article Data Records, without opening spreadsheets. The earlier 1997–2015 China accounts are a separate G1 draft, not an existing catalogue match. The related 1997–2015 accounts are a separate G1 draft; their sector definitions need checking before a time-series join.
